reason: I already have a supplement I reorder when it runs out, and a drawer full of half-used bottles. I don't need one more thing to keep track of, even if the lab report is a nice touch.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A named lab is better than most, but I'd have to check the report myself, and $29.99 a month is more than I want to pay for magnesium when I already have a routine.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price, around $20 for the month, plus a lab report I could actually open and verify before paying.
